name: work-panel-refresh
goal: Keep expanded feature work rows stable during committed queue refreshes.

evidence: On the local owner console, collapsing the first feature and waiting for the five-second queue refresh reopens it; selection must survive unchanged and changed committed snapshots.

The agent-creation component scenario in compact-agent.spec.ts verifies chat and Agents at each viewport but never supplies projectWork or checks disclosure state after its polling lifecycle. Extend that same registered viewport case with a synthetic queue and assertions before and after both unchanged and changed refreshes.
